Content: Agent-facing repository instructions are organized in a three-tier hierarchy. (1) .github/agents/smith.agent.md is the canonical workflow contract for Agent Smith — it defines task tracking, evidence standards, skill-first workflow, and dogfooding behavior. (2) .github/copilot-instructions.md provides repository-wide Copilot behavior guidance including project map, execution standards, and NUnit/MVVM conventions. (3) .continue/rules/memory-smith.md mirrors the Smith agent contract for Continue.dev users. The runtime chat prompt is MemorySmith.Core/Docs/Prompts/wiki-chat-agent.md (Athena). Maintenance prompts live in Prompts/maintenance-agent-task.md, maintenance-proposal-generation.md, and maintenance-revision-cycle.md. When updating agent behavior, keep smith.agent.md aligned with copilot-instructions.md and the Continue rules. Treat smith.agent.md as the primary source of truth; backfill others after Smith prompt changes.
Title: Agent Instructions Source of Truth
